title: [main] Bug 649837 Export to Excel All exported rows if Show Currency is enabled in General Ledger Setup.
summary: Fixed an issue where exporting to Excel applied a selected currency to all exported rows when Show Currency was enabled in General Ledger Setup by hiding the unreleased currency feature.
key_points: The Show Currency field on the General Ledger Setup page extension is now hidden
Removes the entry point that caused Excel export to apply one purchase order currency to all rows
The underlying currency feature was not intended for release
quote: Added field Visible= false as reference bug suggests the feature is not released.
